source.publication: 2025 Maryland Resident Booklet (State and Local Tax Forms and Instructions), Form 502
source.section: Form 502 Lines 1, 7, 15-21; Instruction 16 standard deduction (PDF page 21); Instruction 10 and Exemption Amount Chart 10A (PDF pages 12-13); Instruction 17 Tax Rate Schedule I (PDF page 22); Chart 10A row over 100,000 not over 125,000 ($1,600); Worksheet Schedules 17A (PDF page 41)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 110,000.00 = 110,000.00. Federal taxable income = 110,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 94,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 502 Line 1 federal AGI 110,000.00; Lines 2-6 additions 0.00 (no non-Maryland municipal interest); Line 7 total 110,000.00. Line 14 two-income subtraction: 0.00 (not a joint return). Line 15 total subtractions 0.00. Line 16 Maryland AGI = 110,000.00 - 0.00 = 110,000.00. Line 17 standard deduction (Instruction 16, flat by filing status) = 3,350.00. Line 18 net income = 110,000.00 - 3,350.00 = 106,650.00. Line 19 exemptions: Chart 10A at federal AGI 110,000.00 (not over 125,000) gives 1,600.00 each x 1 (Box A) = 1,600.00. Line 20 taxable net income = 106,650.00 - 1,600.00 = 105,050.00. Line 21 tax, Schedule I as numbers: 2.00% x 1,000.00 = 20.00 + 3.00% x 1,000.00 = 30.00 + 4.00% x 1,000.00 = 40.00 + 4.75% x 97,000.00 = 4,607.50 + 5.00% x 5,050.00 = 252.50; total 4,950.00. (Taxable net income is 100,000 or more, so the form uses Worksheet Schedules 17A, the same formula: 4,950.00.) Lines 22-26 credits: none modelled or claimed, 0.00; Maryland state tax 4,950.00. Local tax (Lines 28-33) out of scope; 2% capital gain tax (Line 21b) not charged (no gains, AGI under 350,000).
